rows.qualification_required: Eligibility criteria for Assistant Professor (Guest) shall be as per the UGC Regulations, 2018, as adopted by the University of Delhi and UGC. Superannuated (retired) teachers may also be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty, subject to the maximum age limit of 70 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend Ramjas College Guest Faculty Interview
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria as per UGC Regulations, 2018. Prepare a detailed Bio-Data. Gather all original certificates and supporting documents. Report at the Office of the Principal, Ramjas College, University of Delhi on 14 October 2026 between 01:00 P.M. and 01:55 P.M. Attend the interview at 02:15 P.M.

content_sections.heading: Ramjas College Guest Faculty Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No candidate will be entertained after 01:55 P.M. reporting time. No interview letters are being issued by the College in this regard. The maximum age limit for superannuated (retired) teachers is 70 years. Candidates must bring their Bio-Data along with all original certificates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The College reserves the right to change the nature/number of positions or cancel the interview at any stage without prior notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by Ramjas College?
faq.answer: Ramjas College has invited candidates for a Guest Faculty position in the Department of Philosophy under the EWS category.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 leave vacancy available under the EWS category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 14 October 2026 at 02:15 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time is between 01:00 P.M. and 01:55 P.M. No candidate will be entertained after 01:55 P.M.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the Office of the Principal, Ramjas College, University of Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Qualifications are as per UGC Regulations, 2018, as adopted by the University of Delhi and UGC.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Are retired teachers eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, superannuated (retired) teachers may also be considered subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates need to bring original certificates?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must bring their Bio-Data along with all original certificates to the interview.
